title: Japanese café basics
learner_outcome: At a café, greet the staff, order one drink, ask a price and answer a simple follow-up question in Japanese using standard polite forms, with romaji and furigana available as scaffolds.

time_estimate.rationale: Derived from the declared 75 minutes per week and three sections; it schedules practice, it does not promise attainment.

objectives.title: Greet café staff and open the interaction politely
evidence_criteria: Produces a greeting in Japanese script
Chooses a greeting appropriate to entering a shop

objectives.title: Order one drink using a polite request form
Distinguish これ / それ / あれ when pointing at menu items
evidence_criteria: Selects the demonstrative that matches the speaker's distance from the item

objectives.title: Understand a staff follow-up question about drink size
evidence_criteria: Identifies that a size choice was requested
Answers with one of the offered sizes

sections.title: Greeting and opening
sections.lesson_intent: Model one polite greeting, then have the learner produce it cold before seeing romaji removed.

sections.title: Ordering a drink
sections.lesson_intent: Model one polite request form, then have the learner order a single drink with it.

sections.title: This, that and over there
sections.lesson_intent: Point at three menu items at different distances and choose これ / それ / あれ each time.

sections.title: Price and follow-up
sections.lesson_intent: Ask a price, then recognise and answer a size question.

check_plan.notes: Selection check on a greeting, no romaji in the stimulus.

exclusions: No claim of native-speaker naturalness: wording and usage still need fresh sourcing.
No pronunciation assessment from text or generic TTS.
No keigo beyond standard polite forms.
